topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I stepped into the quiet of my room, expecting the usual sanctuary, but the air felt heavy, charged with an unseen energy. I opened my laptop, and there it was, my words, my thoughts, laid bare in an online example of a college application essay. My room seemed to close in around me, the walls too close, the air too thin. It was strange seeing my words, my story, picked apart and laid out for others to critique, as if I were watching a shadow of myself from a distance, unsure if I could reach out and pull it back. The silence seemed louder now, filled with the echoes of what I had written, what I had shared, and the unseen eyes that had read it.
